visual_brief: China Zun is a silver-blue, vertically ribbed tower with a narrow waist, a widening base and a broad, gently concave crown, inspired by a ritual wine vessel. It rises over Beijing’s dense CBD; a three-quarter view from the surrounding streets or an elevated viewpoint best reveals its vase-like outline. Distinguish it from the straight-sided China World Trade Center towers, the angular loop-shaped CCTV headquarters, and the unrelated CITIC Tower in Hong Kong.
notes: Six distinct photographs retained and visually checked. Best full-building candidate: c4; best freely licensed portrait: c5, followed by c6. Most city views have some base obstruction, specified individually. No reference image was reused. Downloads used Node fetch after Python and curl failed locally; every retained file was decoded and measured.
